name: it-income-tax
description: Italian personal income tax (IRPEF) for self-employed professionals (lavoratori autonomi, liberi professionisti) under the regime ordinario, tax year 2026, filed in 2027. Covers the 2026 bands (23%, 33%, 43%; the middle rate cut from 35% by the Legge di Bilancio 2026, L. 199/2025), the art. 13 detrazioni for self-employed, employment and pension income and their phase-outs, the cuneo fiscale in brief, the 19% detrazioni and their cuts above EUR 75,000, 120,000 and 200,000, regional and municipal surcharges, the cash-basis professional income rules and expense limits, the 20% withholding on fees, the forfettario test and the expired flat tax incrementale, Modello Redditi PF and 730 deadlines, acconti, penalties and ravvedimento. Trigger on: IRPEF autonomo, Quadro RE, Redditi PF, detrazioni, addizionale regionale, ritenuta d'acconto 20%, ravvedimento. Out of scope, see: it-irpef-employees, it-regime-forfettario, it-estimated-tax, it-inps-contributions, it-impatriati, italy-payroll, italy
